event_name: Time 20:45 2019 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 September 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between car 27 and car 55 in turn 5.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code, read with Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that at turn 5 on the first lap, Sainz was taking a wide, traditional racing line; Hulkenburg took an inside line to pass. Sainz would not have reasonably seen the car on his inside and moved aggressively towards the apex of turn 5. As a result of both cars' actions, they collided and the Stewards determined that this was a first lap racing incident and take No Further Action.
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: determined that this was a first lap racing incident
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 27 Turn 5 Incident With Car 55
to: The Team Manager, Renault F1 Team
